general_protocol: General Cross-Project Research Protocol v0.7.4 FINAL
question: Across an ordinary synthetic coupling and carrier-geometry landscape, how do carrier correspondence, participation, embedded response, intervention response, and coupling specificity change before and through regions of weak or ambiguous correspondence?

model.geometry_transform: orthogonal rotation of clean substrate carrier geometry in planes (0,1) by theta and (2,3) by 0.6*theta while preserving the clean substrate eigenvalue spectrum before parent-child coupling is added
model.shared_coordinate_mapping: identity physical coordinate map; only the substrate stiffness geometry is changed, so the geometry transform is a physical synthetic perturbation rather than a coordinate relabeling

intervention.rule: The intervention coordinate, delta, probe frequency, and response are fixed before FM1 output is opened.

carrier_metrics.parent_to_child_directional_overlap: squared overlap between parent clean modes and normalized child substrate projections
carrier_metrics.child_substrate_participation: mass-weighted fraction of each full child mode supported on the four substrate coordinates
carrier_metrics.carrier_assignment: injective parent-to-child assignment maximizing total directional overlap; full overlap matrix and participation remain separately retained
carrier_metrics.frequency_only_comparator: injective assignment minimizing total absolute natural-frequency difference; the carrier overlap of that assignment is reported separately
carrier_metrics.frequency_only_comparator_role: simple native baseline for the scalar/frequency false-friend question only; it is not asserted to be the strongest future P1 standard toolkit

embedded_response_metrics.response_curve: complex substrate self-energy on the child coordinate across the frozen probe frequencies
embedded_response_metrics.response_curve_norm: Euclidean norm of the complex self-energy curve
embedded_response_metrics.coupling_rewire_specificity: relative Euclidean change in the self-energy curve after the frozen coupling-weight permutation at the same total coupling scale
embedded_response_metrics.intervention_response: Euclidean magnitude of the complex finite-difference derivative of child self-energy with respect to the frozen parent-coordinate stiffness perturbation

function_map_targets: ordinary regions with high carrier correspondence and nontrivial substrate participation
continuous growth or redistribution of embedded response with coupling
regions where coupling rewiring changes embedded response despite preserved total coupling scale
regions where parent intervention produces measurable child response
cases where frequency matching remains good while carrier correspondence changes
limit_map_targets: low substrate participation despite apparently favorable directional overlap
response regions with weak coupling specificity
ill-conditioned dynamic-stiffness probe points if encountered
controls: coupling_scale=0 must produce zero child substrate self-energy, zero rewire specificity, and zero intervention transfer
theta=0 and coupling_scale=0 must reproduce the parent carrier basis exactly on the substrate-supported child modes
at coupling_scale=0 the carrier-geometry transform preserves the clean substrate eigenvalue spectrum to numerical precision
no Atlas coordinate or chi used for parameter selection
